facts.old_value: Tests transitions in this exact priority order: side special; rapid jab; ftCo_800D6824; ftCo_800D68C0; grab; side, up, and down smash; side, up, and down tilt; neutral attack; ftCo_80099794; ftCo_80091A4C; side appeal; ftCo_800DE9D8; jump; dash; ftCo_800D5FB0; turn; then walk. The first true result returns immediately and suppresses later checks; if all return false, this invocation performs no accepted transition.

evidence.why: Exact ordered short-circuit predicates.
Address-named predicates dispatch neutral/down specials; misleading Attack100 name dispatches up special.
Squat threshold and entry behind address-named predicate.

facts.subject: main/melee/ft/kinds/ftCommon/ftCo_Wait:ftCo_Wait_Phys
facts.old_value: Receives the Wait-state fighter game object and passes it unchanged to both helpers. The movement helper reads the fighter's co_attrs.ground_friction, gr_vel, and co_attrs.walk_max_vel, scales friction by p_ftCommonData->friction_when_above_walk_speed when absolute ground velocity exceeds maximum walk speed, applies that friction to ground velocity, and then applies ground movement before ftColl_8007AEE0 runs.
facts.reason: Distinguish queued acceleration from immediate velocity mutation and identify the actual followup flag write.
facts.replacement_value: Forwards the Wait fighter object to ft_80084F3C and then ftColl_8007AEE0. The first helper selects ground friction, scaling it above walk_max_vel, and stores friction as primary ground acceleration before projecting ground movement. It does not directly subtract from gr_vel; the shared fighter update later integrates pending acceleration. The second helper clears shield_hit.skip_update_pos.

evidence.why: Friction/movement helper precedes ftColl flag update.
Above-walk-speed friction scaling.
Friction writes primary ground acceleration rather than directly changing gr_vel.
Ground-normal projections and surface multiplier.
Subsequent integration adds pending accelerations and clears them.
Followup clears shield_hit.skip_update_pos.
Wait active callback row.
